conbody.p: Tests starts with the project's newest test runs as cards. Each bar shows the run's passes in green, fails in red and blocked results in amber out of every test case in the project; the rest are still to go. Select a card to open the run and record results.

Below, Test cases lists every test case with its method (automated, manual or physical), the requirements it verifies, its last result and the run that recorded it, and its number of steps: the numbered steps in its text. Last result: fail, blocked narrows the list to what needs attention, and Method to one kind of test. The Runs tab lists the newest runs as a table.
On a phone, Tests leads with the run in progress and a button to continue it, then the recent runs and the test cases failing or blocked.
